experiment.name: Document upload: plain-language requirements list
experiment.description: Applicants must upload proof-of-identity and proof-of-income documents to finish a benefits application. Support staff report that applicants frequently upload the wrong document type, are asked to resubmit, and some abandon the application at that point. The tested version replaces a dense paragraph of requirements with a short checklist naming each accepted document and showing an example of each. No eligibility rule, required document, or policy changes; only the on-screen explanation of what to upload.

hypothesis.statement: If applicants are shown a plain-language checklist of accepted documents instead of a requirements paragraph, more of them will successfully complete the upload step on their first attempt, without increasing calls to the support line.

plain_language_checklist.description: Checklist naming each accepted document, with an example of each

primary.name: completion_rate
primary.definition: Share of applicants who reach the document upload step and successfully submit their documents, counted once per applicant.

guardrails.name: error_rate
guardrails.definition: Share of applicants who hit a blocking error during upload.

guardrails.name: support_contact_rate
guardrails.definition: Share of applicants who contact the support line during the upload step.

guardrails.name: time_to_complete
guardrails.definition: Seconds from reaching the upload step to a successful submission.
